metadata.description: Official CodeceptJS 4 skills — orientation, authoring, debugging, refactoring, and CI auto-repair for any AI agent that supports the Agent Skills standard.

plugins.name: codeceptjs
plugins.description: Thirteen skills covering everything an AI agent needs to write, debug, refactor, migrate, and fix CodeceptJS 4 tests — a primer (codeceptjs-fundamentals), live page exploration (codeceptjs-exploration), trace analysis (codeceptjs-run-analysis), the auth plugin recipe (codeceptjs-auth), four action skills (writing, debugging, refactoring, ci-fix), and five migration skills (migrate-codeceptjs-4 for the 3.x→4.x upgrade, plus migrate-cypress / migrate-protractor / migrate-testcafe / migrate-selenium-java-to-codeceptjs).
